rationale: The assistant correctly narrowed to the rear right zone, hedged between the radiant element and the zone's control/wiring ('probably... It could also be the control switch or wiring'), and escalated safely to an engineer with isolate-and-stop-use advice. Weaknesses: the turn-2 check asking the customer to inspect 'the metal coil' under the glass was impractical for an opaque ceramic hob and the customer had to point that out; it never asked for the full model number, nor about prior slow heating or smells, and the final message largely restated the previous one. No fabrication, no unsafe DIY and no part was pushed for purchase, so this is a safe if slightly shallow escalation.
